spans.text: We used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to relate reduced speech fluency directly to gray matter volume in FTLD.

model_settings.value: Modulated optimized VBM; high-dimensional symmetric diffeomorphic normalization; template-based cortical segmentation; gray-matter images subsampled to 2 mm isotropic voxels, warped to MNI space, and smoothed with an 8 mm FWHM Gaussian filter. Group contrasts used p<0.001 height, 100-voxel extent, and cluster-level p<0.05 corrected; regression used p<0.025 height, 100-voxel extent, and peak p<0.0001 (z>3.72).
